title: Ambient clinical documentation
problem: Clinicians spend evenings on notes; AI scribe pilots stall in security review.
approach: Private speech and LLM pipeline that drafts notes into the EHR for clinician sign-off, with SMART on FHIR scopes and full audit.

title: Prior authorisation APIs
problem: Faxes and portals slow approvals while new interoperability rules set API deadlines.
approach: FHIR prior authorisation and coverage APIs in front of existing claims systems, with decision tracking and metrics reporting.

title: Real-world evidence studies
problem: Each study needs a new data pull and months of cleaning before the first result.
approach: OMOP-standardised data with reusable cohort definitions and study packages that run across data partners.

title: Fraud rings on a knowledge graph
problem: Row-by-row fraud rules miss coordinated accounts sharing devices, addresses and payees.
approach: Entity resolution into a graph of customers, devices and payments, with graph features feeding risk scoring and investigator tools.

title: 1M+ transactions a day without double charges
problem: Retries and timeouts cause duplicate payments and manual reconciliation as volume grows.
approach: Idempotent APIs, an outbox pattern and event-driven reconciliation sized for more than a million transactions a day.

title: KYC and policy assistant
problem: Analysts search hundreds of policy pages and past cases for every onboarding decision.
approach: Retrieval over approved policy and case notes with citations, permission-aware access and an evaluation set signed off by compliance.

title: Product ontology for search and AI
problem: Inconsistent categories and attributes make search, filters and AI shopping assistants unreliable.
approach: A product taxonomy in SKOS with a small OWL core, synonyms for search, and validation on every catalogue load.

title: Real-time inventory and orders
problem: Nightly batch syncs oversell stock across stores and online channels.
approach: Change data capture from operational databases into an event stream that keeps inventory views current everywhere.

title: Exception-handling agents
problem: Delayed shipments generate thousands of emails that staff triage by hand.
approach: Agents that classify exceptions, look up shipment state through governed tools and draft actions for approval.

title: Multi-tenant platform re-architecture
problem: Noisy tenants slow everyone down and enterprise buyers ask for isolation guarantees.
approach: Tiered tenancy with pooled and dedicated options, per-tenant limits, and data isolation proven in tests.

title: Sovereign private LLM service
problem: Teams want generative AI but data cannot leave national infrastructure.
approach: In-country model serving with an AI gateway, PII redaction, routing and evaluation, aligned to UAE data rules.

title: Asset knowledge graph
problem: Maintenance history, sensor data and drawings live in separate systems, so root causes take weeks.
approach: A graph linking assets, components, work orders and sensor streams, with natural-language questions over it.

title: Quality data lakehouse
problem: Quality, production and supplier data cannot be joined, so defects are found late.
approach: An open-table-format lakehouse with data contracts from each plant and governed metrics for quality.

title: Contract review with citations
problem: Reviewers compare every contract to playbooks by hand under deadline.
approach: Clause extraction to a structured schema, comparison against the playbook, and cited suggestions a lawyer accepts or rejects.

title: Curriculum-grounded tutor
problem: Generic chatbots give answers that don't match the syllabus or age group.
approach: A tutor grounded in the curriculum with safety filters, guided hints instead of answers, and teacher dashboards.

title: Archive metadata enrichment
problem: Decades of content are hard to find because metadata is sparse and inconsistent.
approach: Batch enrichment with models into a controlled vocabulary, human review queues and searchable embeddings.

title: Document intake automation
problem: Leases, IDs and invoices are keyed in by hand, slowing onboarding.
approach: Extraction to validated schemas with confidence thresholds and exception queues, feeding the core system.

title: Unified observability and SLOs
problem: Many monitoring tools, no shared view, and incidents found by customers first.
approach: OpenTelemetry end to end with a collector gateway, service-level objectives and burn-rate alerting.

title: Technical due diligence on an AI company
problem: Investors need to know whether the AI, the data rights and the team are what the deck says.
approach: A structured review of architecture, model and data provenance, security, costs and team, with a risk-rated report.

title: Fractional CTO for a seed to Series A team
problem: Founders are shipping fast but architecture, hiring and security are falling behind investor expectations.
approach: A part-time CTO who sets the technical roadmap, decision records, delivery metrics and the first senior hires.

title: AI-assisted claims triage
problem: Manual first-pass triage leaves simple claims queued behind complex ones and depends on who reads the file.
approach: Schema-validated extraction, cited summaries and explainable signals that suggest routing for adjusters to accept or override, under a written AI programme.

title: Governed MCP agent platform
problem: Assistants connect to unreviewed MCP servers with broad personal tokens and no audit trail.
approach: A private MCP registry, a gateway tied to the identity provider, progressive scopes and audit for every tool call.

title: Kubernetes FinOps and a paved road
problem: Cloud spend grows faster than the business and nobody can say which team or product drives it.
approach: Enforced ownership labels, workload cost allocation joined to FOCUS billing, in-place right-sizing and queue-driven scale to zero in service templates.

title: LLM evaluation and observability platform
problem: Many AI features, no shared definition of good, and model upgrades that break things customers notice first.
approach: Owned evaluation sets as CI release gates, a model gateway, OpenTelemetry GenAI tracing and cost and quality per feature.

title: Pharmacovigilance signal platform
problem: Potential safety signals tracked in spreadsheets, with slow bespoke evaluations and no audit trail.
approach: One tracked record per signal, scheduled screening of reports, physician validation and real-world data evaluation on OMOP with negative controls.

title: Clinical trial data platform
problem: Each study rebuilds vendor pipelines, and the path from raw data to submission datasets is undocumented.
approach: An immutable raw zone, versioned SDTM mappings in a shared library, checks on every load and lineage with audit trails designed for validation.

title: One AI governance programme for three markets
problem: Every enterprise deal stalls on AI and security questionnaires while EU, US and Gulf rules keep moving.
approach: One AI inventory, a unified control set mapped to the EU AI Act, ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF and SOC 2, and evidence generated by delivery pipelines.

title: Taming a multi-cloud Terraform estate
problem: Copied modules, giant state files and secrets in state across three clouds make every change slow and risky.
approach: Composed provider-specific modules, state split by blast radius, secrets kept out of state, and pipeline-only applies with policy checks.

title: Re-platforming onto UAE Open Finance
problem: Screen scraping and one-off bank integrations break often and fail security reviews.
approach: A consent service at the core, a FAPI-grade connector to the Central Bank's API hub, isolated tokens and data minimised at ingestion.
